message.c58f25c5293e.source: 5h 刷新机制不代表从每次请求重新计时。这是当前计划的假设推演；失败、跳过、手动或外部请求可能改变实际窗口。真实重置时间需要账号级上游依据。
message.c58f25c5293e.en: A 5h refresh does not establish a new timer for every request. This projection can differ from actual usage. Confirm resets using account-level upstream data.
